Stage.LogText: {=sp_ai_s1_log}The mysterious barber's words haunt your mind. An old friend from your motherland, {Dost_Link}, has asked the secret society 'Scavenger Pigeons' for help to fight against terrible slanders that will ruin your reputation. However, before the Pigeons accept you, you must prove your strength. Use the gold you were given to gather a company of 70 men and meet with the village elder {KoyBuyugu_Link}.

{=sp_ai_s2_log}You spoke with the village elder {KoyBuyugu_Link}. As expected, this was no ordinary task. He gave you a piece of leather with secret ciphers on it and told you to deliver it to the artisan {ArtisanTarget_Link} in the city of {UzakSehir_Link} without wasting any time.
{=sp_ai_s3a_log}The Scavenger Pigeons' sage, {ArtisanTarget_Link}, gave you an assassination mission. You accepted it without question. Your target: {Dost_Link}.

{=sp_ai_s3b_log}The Pigeons have asked you to kill {Dost_Link}, the person they previously said was your friend. Inconsistent and strange things are happening. You objected to the mission during your conversation with {ArtisanTarget_Link}. You might want to urgently speak to someone about your suspicions.

{=sp_ai_s_bekleme_log}{ArtisanTarget_Link} has been slandering you behind your back. When he gave you that suspicious assassination mission, you should have spoken to someone. Your name is quickly being tarnished among the looters. You have no choice but to retreat to a dark corner and wait, perhaps there is another way to solve this.
{=sp_ai_s4_savas_log}You must be the traitor. You are the one who slandered me. Prepare to die! You fought {Dost_Link}. There is no turning back!

{=sp_ai_s5_karanlik_log}Executing someone has never led to anything good. The Pigeons have declared you a traitor. For your motherland, you are now an open enemy. They hate you. It shouldn't have been like this...

{=sp_ai_s4_inandi_log}You spoke with the looter and learned your true mission. They will deal with the traitorous Artisan. Now you must speak with the Kingdom Leader {Kral_Link} and find a way to offer your services.

{=sp_ai_s5_katil_log}You proved yourself and joined the kingdom. Now it is time to find the person who slandered you and take your revenge. {Dost_Link} is waiting to speak with you. Talk to him and learn the details.

{=sp_ai_s_success_log}You learned that all of this was a game set up to test your loyalty. It turns out you have just met your friend {Dost_Link}. He gave you 50,000 denars as compensation for the troubles he caused and wished you success in your new service. The rumors of treason have ended.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_ai_dlg1}The barber directed me to you regarding the matter of {Dost_Link}.
{=sp_ai_dlg2}Your name must be {PlayerName}, isn't it?
{=sp_ai_dlg2}Your name must be {PlayerName}, isn't it?
{=sp_ai_dlg3}I guess I should get used to everyone knowing my name.
{=sp_ai_dlg4}You must be a pigeon too...

{=sp_ai_dlg5}Yes, of course... Your friend {Dost_Link} sent word about you. You are here for the next step. What you will do now is take this special leather containing secret information to the artisan named {ArtisanTarget_Link} in the city of {UzakSehir_Link}.
{=sp_ai_dlg6}What does this have to do with my problem?
{=sp_ai_dlg7}Everything is connected.
{=sp_ai_dlg8}Alright, I will do it.
{=sp_ai_dlg9}Safe travels, looter...
{=sp_ai_dlg10}Thank you, pigeon...
{=sp_ai_dlg11}A pigeon sent you this leather.
{=sp_ai_dlg12}Ahh, another conspiracy! Tell me looter, what is your name?
{=sp_ai_dlg13}Anubis.
{=sp_ai_dlg14}Pigeon.
{=sp_ai_dlg15}{PlayerName}.
{=sp_ai_dlg16}Does a baby pigeon return to its nest?
{=sp_ai_dlg17}It returns.
{=sp_ai_dlg18}It does not return.
{=sp_ai_dlg19}Does it not return?
{=sp_ai_dlg20}Of course! So, do you seek justice or revenge?
{=sp_ai_dlg21}Justice must be served! For its greatness is eternal.
{=sp_ai_dlg22}My revenge will ensure that justice is manifested.
{=sp_ai_dlg23}An eye for an eye, blood for blood. REVENGE, REVENGE!!
{=sp_ai_dlg24}Alright, we have come to a conclusion. The treason of the motherland will end with your iron fist. Your current mission is to execute the person named {Dost_Link}.
{=sp_ai_dlg25}What?! I was told this man is my friend. This is absurd, you are hiding something. I will not do this!
{=sp_ai_dlg26}At your command! The looter's order is the pigeon's duty, if you'll excuse me...
{=sp_ai_dlg27}I have a special matter to discuss with you.
{=sp_ai_dlg28}I have a special matter to discuss with you.
{=sp_ai_dlg29}My friend, you're early. You haven't even entered the service of the Motherland yet.
{=sp_ai_dlg29}My friend, you're early. You haven't even entered the service of the Motherland yet.
{=sp_ai_dlg29}My friend, you're early. You haven't even entered the service of the Motherland yet.
{=sp_ai_dlg30}Death came early. When you least expected it.
{=sp_ai_dlg31}A looter wants your head. Be careful not to be left to my mercy.
{=sp_ai_dlg32}What nonsense are you spouting? They take orders from me. This means there is a traitor among them who thinks they've fooled you!
{=sp_ai_dlg33}You're right, what was I thinking. I'll go talk to the village elder for you.
{=sp_ai_dlg35}Yes. You must be the traitor. You are the one who slandered me. Prepare to die!
{=sp_ai_dlg34}That was a terrifying encounter, my friend. Take care of yourself. We will meet again.
{=sp_ai_dlg36}We need to talk about {ArtisanTarget_Link}.
{=sp_ai_dlg37}Your return is an unexpected development. Is there a problem?
{=sp_ai_dlg37}Your return is an unexpected development. Is there a problem?
{=sp_ai_dlg38}{ArtisanTarget_Link} gave me the name {Dost_Link} to kill.
{=sp_ai_dlg39}The artisan wanted me to kill the man who is our friend.
{=sp_ai_dlg40}Kill? And our friend no less? Are you sure about this? Why should I believe you? The person you accuse is a valuable looter.
{=sp_ai_dlg41}You are right. You might not want to believe me. But you should know that I will not carry out this mission.
{=sp_ai_dlg42}I don't care. I will not kill anyone. I am not going to bother convincing you either!
{=sp_ai_dlg43}I am sorry, Yes! You are not lying. How many times has this happened... That man is a traitor!
{=sp_ai_dlg44}Maybe it's none of my business, but if you want, I can take care of that man for you...
{=sp_ai_dlg45}That man! He thought he could use me, huh. Now I'll show him...

{=sp_ai_dlg46}No! This is not your affair. Go and show your dedication to serving the Motherland before it is too late. That should have been your true mission. I must go now. Your service will not be forgotten.
{=sp_ai_dlg47_p}I have returned, friend.

{=sp_ai_dlg47}{PLAYER.NAME}! You have finally pledged your allegiance to {Kral_Link}. I wanted to see you as well. There was never any slander against you. I played this game to convince you to enter the service of the motherland. There was no traitor. In fact, we were never friends in the past either.

{=sp_ai_dlg47}{PLAYER.NAME}! You have finally pledged your allegiance to {Kral_Link}. I wanted to see you as well. There was never any slander against you. I played this game to convince you to enter the service of the motherland. There was no traitor. In fact, we were never friends in the past either.
{=sp_ai_dlg48}Absolutely! I already knew I didn't know you. Actually, I always had serving the Motherland in mind anyway.
{=sp_ai_dlg49}Don't think you fooled me. I already wanted to go down this path myself. The slander was just an added bonus.
{=sp_ai_dlg50}Thank you. The donation I'm about to make will compensate for the trouble I've caused you and help you in your new service.
{=sp_ai_dlg50_acc}The Motherland's honor is preserved, and 50,000 denars is a fitting recompense. I accept. (Accept 50,000 Gold)
{=sp_ai_dlg51}May your blade serve the realm well. Farewell, friend.
